ads.name: 2 Facials for $64.99 — Tuesdays
ads.audience: Adults 21–60 within ~10 mi of Cielo Vista Mall; broad (Advantage+ audience), no interest stacking.
ads.primaryTextA: TWO FACIALS. ONE PRICE. 🔥 Every Tuesday at Solace Skin Lab: 2 facials for $64.99 total. Bring your bestie, your mom, your sister or your partner — self-care is better together. Tuesday spots are limited.
ads.primaryTextB: Yes, you read that right: TWO facials for only $64.99 — Tuesdays only at Solace Skin Lab, El Paso. Tag who you're bringing and message us to save your Tuesday spot.
ads.description: Cielo Vista Mall, El Paso • Message us to book
ads.optimization: Conversations; run Sun night → Tue 2 pm, pause Wed–Sat.
ads.compliance: Price covers BOTH facials together; state 'Tuesdays only' and limited spots only if true. No before/after.

ads.name: Microneedling — Learn More
ads.audience: Adults 25–55 within ~15 mi of Cielo Vista Mall; broad (no condition-based targeting).
ads.primaryTextA: Why does everyone talk about microneedling? 👀 It's a professional treatment that may help improve the appearance of uneven texture, enlarged-looking pores, fine lines and acne scarring over a series of sessions. Message us to learn if it's right for you.
ads.primaryTextB: Ready to take skincare to the next level? Microneedling at Solace Skin Lab may help smooth the look of texture and scarring. Honest consultation first — message us.
ads.description: Cielo Vista Mall, El Paso • Message us to book
ads.compliance: Meta personal-attributes policy: never say or imply 'your acne/your scars'. 'May help', results vary, no before/after.

ads.name: BOTOX® Cosmetic — Injector Consultation
ads.audience: Adults 30–60 within ~15 mi; plus retarget 60-day page engagers.
ads.primaryTextA: Let's talk BOTOX®. The goal isn't looking dramatically different — for many clients it's a refreshed appearance while still looking like themselves. Book an injector consultation at Solace Skin Lab. Individual results vary.
ads.primaryTextB: "How many units of BOTOX® do I need?" There's no universal number — it depends on the areas, your anatomy and your goals. That's why your injector evaluates YOU. Schedule a consultation.
ads.description: Cielo Vista Mall, El Paso • Message us to book
ads.compliance: Prescription product: consultation framing, results vary, include Important Safety Information per Allergan guidance before activation; 18+; no before/after, no price claims.
